name: Matsuyama (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Matsuyama town emblem in black: a disc pierced by a white stylised arrow pointing upwards.
history: Flag of the former town of Matsuyama in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 January 1969.

features.role: Matsuyama town emblem — a disc pierced by a white stylised arrow pointing upwards
